title: personal-okr-draft-zoe-kim-2026-03-20
content:
Personal OKR draft + weekly check-in (working notes)

Context / purpose:
- Drafting my Q2 personal OKRs and the weekly checkpoints I will use to measure progress.
- Focus areas: reduce tail latency variance for CPU-backed transformer inference, improve onboarding docs for model quantization workflows, and mentorship / hiring support.
- Notes to self: keep OKRs measurable, tied to team goals, and realistic given bandwidth (on-call + product work).

Draft OKRs (Q2 2026)
O1: Improve inference latency stability for p99 across common workloads
KR1.1: Reduce p99 tail latency by 30% on batch sizes 1-8 for 7B models (baseline: 220ms -> target ~155ms)
KR1.2: Reduce incidents related to KV cache thrashing from 6/month to <=2/month
KR1.3: Add automated p99 monitoring and alerting in console for top 5 customer routes (dashboard + alert runbook)

O2: Lower per-token cost for production chat workloads via smarter batching/caching
KR2.1: Implement adaptive batching prototype in runtime and validate on 3 production routes (measure: tokens/sec improvement >=20%)
KR2.2: Ship a model quantization guideline doc and migration checklist used by at least 2 internal teams
KR2.3: Identify top 10 prefix reuse patterns and enable prefix caching rules that reduce compute by 15% for demo workload

O3: Grow team effectiveness & onboarding for platform users
KR3.1: Run 4 office hours / walkthrough sessions on quantization + profiling (attendees >= 40 across sessions)
KR3.2: Mentor 1 new hire to full productivity (ramp < 6 weeks on core infra tasks)
KR3.3: Create a short "getting started" runbook for private deployments (5 pages, include KMS/HSM checklist)

Weekly check-in template (quick, for my 1:1 + manager sync)
- Week ending: YYYY-MM-DD
- Wins: one-liner (what shipped / moved forward)
- Metrics / signals: p99, tokens/sec, incidents, PRs merged
- Blockers / risks: anything blocking progress (people, infra, dependencies)
- Next week plan: concrete tasks and owners
- Ask / support needed: ask from manager / other teams

Example: week ending 2026-03-20
- Wins:
  - Prototype adaptive-batching scheduler integrated with runtime (local perf +18% tokens/sec for seq len 512, batch 4)
  - Draft quantization guideline v0.2 PR opened (#678)
- Metrics / signals:
  - p99 (7B, batch 1): 210ms -> prototype micro-optimizations saved 10ms
  - KV cache thrash incidents: 2 this week (one customer report resolved)
  - Tokens/sec improvement on test routes: +18% (needs more samples)
- Blockers / risks:
  - Need better telemetry hooks from dedicated infra team to fetch per-route p99 in real time (blocking KR1.3)
  - On-call rotation next week reduces contiguous dev days
- Next week plan:
  - Align with infra (JIRA INF-3421) to add telemetry endpoint + small API contract doc (owner: Zoe)
  - Run 2 quantization office hours sessions (prep: slides + demo)
  - Finish PR feedback on quantization doc (address L2 comments)
- Ask / support needed:
  - Request 2 days of infra eng time to add telemetry endpoint (need approval from manager)
  - Volunteer help from Liam to run one office hours session

Open questions / rough TODOs (notes to self)
- How tight should KR thresholds be? 30% p99 reduction might be aggressive if kernel-level changes required. Consider 20% locked as "safe" target with stretch 30%.
- Need to quantify "top 5 customer routes" — product can help scope by revenue + error rate. Action: ask PM (Avery) for top routes list.
- Draft runbook: include step-by-step for KMS key rollback + sample Terraform snippets (very useful for private deployments).
- Consider adding a health-check PR that adds synthetic prefix reuse tests to CI to detect regressions early.

Personal notes / tone (scratchpad)
- Keep items short. Don't overcommit. Make clear which KRs are "owner: Zoe" vs shared.
- Hiring: interviewing schedule is heavy; block deep work afternoons for two weeks.
- Mentorship: set up weekly 30m sync with new hire (candidate: Priya)

Possible alignment to team/company goals:
- O1 maps to platform reliability and customer SLAs (connect with SRE and product to get acceptance criteria)
- O2 maps to Redwood Optimize product and will feed into cost savings messaging for sales + customers
- O3 supports scaling operations and reduces onboarding time for Private deployments (strategic focus for Q2)

Immediate next steps (this doc is a scratchpad)
- Send this draft to Avery for feedback (tag in Slack)
- Adjust KR targets after chat with infra + product next Tue
- Convert to a simple Confluence page once stable (title: "Zoe Q2 OKRs 2026 - draft")

Misc notes (choppy)
- PR #678: add example quantized model perf table (need real numbers)
- INF-3421: telemetry endpoint; follow up with Ben in infra meeting on Thu
- Office hours: schedule invites + signup form (Typeform?)

-- end of scratchpad --
